verdict.rationale: Fine-tuning is a fair question for a model vendor, so the axis applies. The vendor's docs state that Jev is not fine-tuned or LoRA-adapted with customer data and that the same weights serve every account, so customization happens only through the request. TypeSafe's own Jev weights are not published; the open-weight Hugging Face replicas are third-party reproductions built on Qwen, not the vendor's models.
